name: Health time series imputation benchmark
description: A benchmarking study that evaluates deep-learning imputation methods for missing values in clinical/health time-series data.
reputation: Used within ML-for-health research as a targeted benchmark for imputation methods, but not a universally standardized clinical benchmark.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark focused on numeric imputation. Common caveats include risk of data leakage/contamination, sensitivity to missingness mechanism, varying dataset sizes across cohorts, and limited generalizability across clinical settings.
